application:security:checkout-client-pri.decision: Rebuild checkout so line items come only from the session user's cart and Product.price_minor; the request carries no items or prices (D04)

application:auth-gap:no-identity-system.decision: Add a new accounts module: email + password (argon2id), server session in an http-only secure cookie, roles customer and owner, one permission check (D05)

application:workflow:purchase-confirmati.decision: Add Order/OrderItem; checkout writes a pending Order; a signature-verified Stripe webhook marks it paid; the review gate needs a paid order containing the product (D04, D08)

database:field-type:cartitem-quantity.decision: CartItem.quantity is integer with a CHECK quantity >= 1, validated on the server; B's text quantities are not migrated (D06)

database:foreign-key:cartitem-product-id.decision: CartItem.product_id is an integer foreign key to products.id (A's keys kept); B's text product ids are not carried over (D02, D06)

dependency:framework:backend-framework.decision: Flask (Python) is the one backend framework; NodeCart's Express endpoints are rebuilt in Flask. The script's 'Express is used by the most sources' is a 1-1 tie, so the choice follows where the adapted code and durable data are (D01)

dependency:framework:data-layer.decision: SQLAlchemy is the one data layer; Prisma is not used (D01, D02)

api:api-version:reviews-path.decision: Unversioned /api/products/{id}/reviews; Reviewly's /v2 path is not copied (D07)

database:naming-style:fields.decision: snake_case for every table and field; B's camelCase names map through compat/aliases.json

migration:product.decision: Approved as a PLAN ONLY (not to be run): copy A's products keeping ids; price_minor = round(price * 100) with a dry run that refuses any price with more than 2 decimals; see design/migration-plan.md. Running it needs a separate migration approval

migration:cart.decision: Approved as a PLAN ONLY: B's Cart rows are not migrated; open NodeCart carts are discarded at cut-over (transient data; customers re-add items); see design/migration-plan.md

migration:cartitem.decision: Approved as a PLAN ONLY: B's CartItem rows are not migrated (text ids and quantities would need re-keying and could be invalid); discarded with their carts; see design/migration-plan.md
